title: Always dreaming about being driven around on busses.
content: Hi. I'm wondering if anyone else ever dreams about being driven on a bus. With a bunch of strangers, being taken somewhere. I constantly am on a bus...like a basic, school bus, except in the dreams, I am my current adult age. And the busses are always full of other people. We are all usually very quiet while being driven. Sometimes I know where I am, for example, once I was near a military complex in a former state I lived years ago. I clearly remember the long drive down the main road, and then as we were about to turn off onto the street towards that military complex, everything went black and my dream switched to something random and silly till I woke up. I'm always "awake" in these dreams; lucid and aware. There's so many of these transportation bus dreams. Anyway, just curious if anyone else has had them. Thank you.
